es.body: Enfoca a tu equipo en el huésped. Nosotros integramos compras, proveedores y logística para hoteles, lodges y operadores gastronómicos de Magallanes.
es.h1: El mercado de Magallanes, para tu cocina.
es.h3: Lo que en el sur no hay, directo a tu cocina.
es.h5: Lo que falta en el sur, directo a tu bodega.
es.h6: Todo lo que el sur debería tener, resuelto desde un solo lugar.
boardRows: Los que el sur no tiene
gar: Múltiples proveedores y orígenes, compras consolidadas y una sola coordinación para tu abastecimiento.
Control de temperatura según la categoría y gestión por lote y vencimiento, desde el origen hasta tu recepción.
Rutas y ventanas de entrega planificadas hacia tu destino en Magallanes.
es.que1: Mercado Patagónico reúne en un solo lugar el abastecimiento de hoteles, lodges, restaurantes y operadores turísticos de Magallanes. Trabajamos con proveedores de Santiago y Puerto Montt y con productores regionales, consolidamos las cargas y las entregamos hasta tu puerta.
es.que2: Ingresa a la plataforma con el usuario que crea nuestro equipo. Revisa el catálogo, haz tus pedidos y sigue cada uno.
es.stepsTitle1: Entra al mercado en cuatro pasos
steps: Nos cuentas de tu operación en un formulario corto.
Revisamos categorías, consumos, frecuencias y tus proveedores actuales.
Un administrador de nuestro equipo crea tu usuario. No hay registro propio. Con él ingresas a la plataforma, ves el catálogo y haces tus pedidos.
Entrega coordinada hasta tu puerta, con seguimiento y trazabilidad de cada pedido.
es.paraSub: Hoteles, lodges, restaurantes, operadores turísticos y casinos de Magallanes: ordena tu abastecimiento.
clientes: Hoteles urbanos: ordena tu compra recurrente
Lodges remotos: protege la continuidad del abastecimiento
Cadenas y grupos: gestiona con una mirada común
Restaurantes, operadores turísticos y casinos: menos proveedores que coordinar
faq: Hoteles, lodges, restaurantes, operadores turísticos y casinos de Magallanes. Contáctanos y revisamos tu caso.
No hay registro propio. Un administrador de nuestro equipo crea tu cuenta cuando nos contactas. Con ese usuario ingresas con el botón Ingresar.
¿Es para reservar una habitación o una mesa?
No. Mercado Patagónico es para quienes compran y abastecen: hoteles, restaurantes, cafés y caterings que necesitan proveerse de productos. Los pedidos se hacen dentro de la plataforma.
Un catálogo multicategoría: alimentos y bebidas (frescos, secos, congelados y refrigerados), limpieza y operación, y amenities y textiles. El catálogo se ve al ingresar.
es.formNote: Te respondemos por correo. ¿Ya tienes cuenta?
es.ctaText: Cuéntanos de tu operación y parte con un piloto acotado y medible. Un administrador de nuestro equipo crea tu cuenta.

Productos críticos que no llegan cuando se necesitan.
Urgencias, menor consolidación y compras reactivas.

en.body: Keep your team focused on the guest. We bring purchasing, suppliers and logistics together for hotels, lodges and food service operators in Magallanes.
en.h1: The Magallanes market, for your kitchen.
en.h3: What the south lacks, straight to your kitchen.
en.h5: What the south lacks, straight to your storeroom.
en.h6: Everything the south should have, solved from a single place.
gar: Multiple suppliers and origins, consolidated purchasing and one point of coordination for your supply.
Temperature control by category and lot and expiry management, from origin to your receiving dock.
Planned routes and delivery windows to your destination in Magallanes.
en.que1: Mercado Patagónico brings the supply of hotels, lodges, restaurants and tour operators in Magallanes into one place. We work with suppliers in Santiago and Puerto Montt and with regional producers, consolidate the loads and deliver them to your door.
en.que2: Log in to the platform with the user our team creates for you. Browse the catalog, place your orders and track each one.
en.stepsTitle1: Enter the market in four steps
steps: Tell us about your operation in a short form.
We review categories, consumption, frequencies and your current suppliers.
An administrator on our team creates your user. There is no self-registration. With it you log in to the platform, see the catalog and place your orders.
You receive and track your order
Coordinated delivery to your door, with tracking and traceability for every order.
en.paraSub: Hotels, lodges, restaurants, tour operators and institutional dining in Magallanes: organize your supply.
clientes: Urban hotels: organize your recurring purchasing
Chains and groups: manage with a shared view
Restaurants, tour operators and institutional dining: fewer suppliers to coordinate
faq: Hotels, lodges, restaurants, tour operators and institutional dining in Magallanes. Contact us and we will review your case.
How do I get my account?
There is no self-registration. An administrator on our team creates your account when you contact us. With that user, you log in with the Log in button.
Is this for booking a room or a table?
No. Mercado Patagónico is for those who buy and stock up: hotels, restaurants, cafés and caterers that need to source products. Orders are placed inside the platform.
A multi-category catalog: food and beverages (fresh, dry, frozen and chilled), cleaning and operations, and amenities and textiles. The catalog is visible after logging in.
en.formNote: We reply by email. Already have an account?
en.ctaText: Tell us about your operation and start with a focused, measurable pilot. An administrator on our team creates your account.
en.footer: Mercado Patagónico is a product of Latitud53.
en.svcText: We make sure you get what cannot be found in the south. You place your orders inside the platform.
svcRows: The ones the south does not have

segCards: Fewer suppliers to coordinate, more orderly receiving and better visibility.
Anticipated planning, critical categories and logistics adapted to the destination.
Standardization, central control and comparison across properties.
en.segMore: We also supply restaurants, tour operators and institutional dining in Magallanes.
en.probSub: When supply fails, the impact reaches rooms, kitchen, maintenance and service. Fragmentation creates a domino effect.
prob: More orders, follow-ups, invoices and receptions.
Critical products that do not arrive when you need them.
Emergencies, less consolidation and reactive purchasing.
Hard to compare spend, prices and performance.
en.probClose: The complexity you manage today is exactly what Mercado Patagónico puts in order.
en.valTitle: Demand a single operator for all your supply.
en.valSub: One operator. Multiple suppliers. One integrated solution.
val: A single operator
Centralize all your supply in one place.

en.valClose: Less complexity for you. More focus on your guests.
en.opTitle: From consumption to delivery, with a visible flow.
en.opSub: We plan, coordinate and control every stage according to the conditions of your destination.
en.lvlTitle: Start where it hurts most. Scale when it works.
en.lvlSub: Choose the level that fits the volume and complexity of your operation.
en.relTitle: Have someone in charge of your supply.
rel: One channel for all your categories.
Follow every order until you receive it.
en.kpiSub: We agree on a baseline with you and track the results.
en.kpiNote: Targets and SLAs are defined with you; no results are assumed before the pilot.
en.pilotTitle: Test before you scale: start with a 90-day pilot.
en.pilotSub: Do not change your whole operation. Validate categories, routes, service and efficiency opportunities.
pilot: Spend, suppliers, consumption and critical points.
en.pilotClose: A focused test. Measurable results. An informed decision to scale.
